meta.milestone: 卡池扩容：由清洗数据集 + K2 解析链生成扩展卡池
meta.admission: 严格准入：仅收录「所有解析条目均已映射到引擎可执行 tag」的卡；任一处未建模即整卡不收（避免部分效果静默丢失）
meta.precedence: 人工卡池 cards_real.json 优先，同名卡不覆盖
meta.honesty: 本池条目为**规则解析链推导**（非人工逐卡校对），装载侧标记为 engine_status=approximated；卡面数值来自清洗数据集，效果保真度取决于解析链召回率，差异见未建模动作清单

cards.desc: Search your deck for a Tera Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

cards.name: Brilliant Blender
cards.desc: Search your deck for up to 5 cards and discard them. Then, shuffle your deck.

cards.name: Team Rocket's Great Ball
cards.desc: Flip a coin. If heads, search your deck for an Evolution Team Rocket’s Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. If tails, search your deck for a Basic Team Rocket’s Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

cards.name: Team Rocket's Transceiver
cards.desc: Search your deck for a Supporter card that has “Team Rocket” in its name, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

cards.name: Energy Coin
cards.desc: Flip 2 coins. If both of them are heads, search your deck for a Basic Energy card and attach it to 1 of your Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck.

cards.name: Fighting Gong
cards.desc: Search your deck for a Basic {F} Energy card or a Basic {F} Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

cards.name: Strange Timepiece
cards.desc: Devolve 1 of your evolved {P} Pokémon by putting any number of Evolution cards on it into your hand. (That Pokémon can’t evolve this turn.)

cards.name: Mega Signal
cards.desc: Search your deck for a Mega Evolution Pokémon {ex}, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

cards.name: Poké Pad
cards.desc: Search your deck for a Pokémon that doesn’t have a Rule Box, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. (Pokémon {ex}, Pokémon {V}, etc. have Rule Boxes.)

cards.name: Survival Brace
cards.desc: If the Pokémon this card is attached to has full HP and would be Knocked Out by damage from an attack from your opponent’s Pokémon, it is not Knocked Out, and its remaining HP becomes 10. Then, discard this card.

cards.name: Lucky Helmet
cards.desc: If the Pokémon this card is attached to is in the Active Spot and is damaged by an attack from your opponent’s Pokémon (even if this Pokémon is Knocked Out), draw 2 cards.

cards.name: Hero’s Cape
cards.desc: The Pokémon this card is attached to gets +100 HP.

cards.name: Handheld Fan
cards.desc: If the Pokémon this card is attached to is in the Active Spot and is damaged by an attack from your opponent’s Pokémon (even if this Pokémon is Knocked Out), move an Energy from the Attacking Pokémon to 1 of your opponent’s Benched Pokémon.

cards.name: Payapa Berry
cards.desc: If the Pokémon this card is attached to is damaged by an attack from your opponent’s {P} Pokémon, it takes 60 less damage (after applying Weakness and Resistance), and discard this card.

cards.name: Deluxe Bomb
cards.desc: If the Pokémon this card is attached to is in the Active Spot and is damaged by an attack from your opponent’s Pokémon (even if this Pokémon is Knocked Out), put 12 damage counters on the Attacking Pokémon. If you placed any damage counters in this way, discard this card.

cards.name: Haban Berry
cards.desc: If the Pokémon this card is attached to is damaged by an attack from your opponent’s {N} Pokémon, it takes 60 less damage (after applying Weakness and Resistance), and discard this card.

cards.name: Air Balloon
cards.desc: The Retreat Cost of the Pokémon this card is attached to is {C}{C} less.

cards.name: Punk Helmet
cards.desc: If the {D} Pokémon this card is attached to is in the Active Spot and is damaged by an attack from your opponent’s Pokémon (even if this Pokémon is Knocked Out), place 4 damage counters on the Attacking Pokémon.

cards.name: Sacred Charm
cards.desc: The Pokémon this card is attached to takes 30 less damage from attacks from your opponent’s Pokémon that have an Ability (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

cards.name: Thick Scale
cards.desc: The {N} Pokémon this card is attached to takes 50 less damage from attacks from your opponent’s {G}, {R}, {W}, or {L} Pokémon (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

cards.name: Perrin
cards.desc: Reveal up to 2 Pokémon in your hand and put them into your deck. If you do, search your deck for up to that many Pokémon, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

cards.name: Explorer’s Guidance
cards.desc: Look at the top 6 cards of your deck and put 2 of them into your hand. Discard the other cards.

cards.name: Ciphermaniac’s Codebreaking
cards.desc: Search your deck for 2 cards, shuffle your deck, then put those cards on top of it in any order.

cards.name: Salvatore
cards.desc: Search your deck for a card that has no Abilities and evolves from 1 of your Pokémon, and put it onto that Pokémon to evolve it. Then, shuffle your deck. You can use this card on a Pokémon you put down when you were setting up to play or on a Pokémon that was put into play this turn.

cards.name: Kieran
cards.desc:
Choose 1:

• Switch your Active Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.
• During this turn, attacks used by your Pokémon do 30 more damage to your opponent’s Active Pokémon {ex} and Active Pokémon {V} (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

cards.name: Hassel
cards.desc:
You can use this card only if any of your Pokémon were Knocked Out during your opponent’s last turn.

Look at the top 8 cards of your deck and put up to 3 of them into your hand. Shuffle the other cards back into your deck.

cards.name: Colress’s Tenacity
cards.desc: Search your deck for a Stadium card and an Energy card, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

cards.name: Janine’s Secret Art
cards.desc: Choose up to 2 of your {D} Pokémon. For each of those Pokémon, search your deck for a Basic {D} Energy card and attach it to that Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck. If you attached Energy to your Active Pokémon in this way, it is now Poisoned.

cards.name: Cassiopeia
cards.desc:
You can use this card only when it is the last card in your hand.

Search your deck for up to 2 cards and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

cards.name: Drayton
cards.desc: Look at the top 7 cards of your deck. You may reveal a Pokémon and a Trainer card you find there and put them into your hand. Shuffle the other cards back into your deck.

cards.name: Surfer
cards.desc: Switch your Active Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon. If you do, draw cards until you have 5 cards in your hand.

cards.name: Cyrano
cards.desc: Search your deck for up to 3 Pokémon {ex}, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

cards.name: Larry’s Skill
cards.desc: Discard your hand and search your deck for a Pokémon, a Supporter card, and a Basic Energy card, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

cards.name: Brock’s Scouting
cards.desc: Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Pokémon or 1 Evolution Pokémon, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

cards.name: Ethan's Adventure
cards.desc: Search your deck for up to 3 in any combination of Ethan’s Pokémon and Basic {R} Energy cards, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

cards.name: Team Rocket's Petrel
cards.desc: Search your deck for a Trainer card, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

cards.name: Team Rocket's Proton
cards.desc:
If you go first, you may use this card during your first turn.

Search your deck for up to 3 Basic Team Rocket’s Pokémon, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

cards.name: Hilda
cards.desc: Search your deck for an Evolution Pokémon and an Energy card, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

cards.name: Dawn
cards.desc: Search your deck for a Basic Pokémon, a Stage 1 Pokémon, and a Stage 2 Pokémon, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

cards.name: Firebreather
cards.desc: Search your deck for up to 7 Basic {R} Energy cards, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

cards.name: Canari
cards.desc:
You can use this card only if you discard another card from your hand.

Search your deck for up to 4 {L} Pokémon, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

cards.name: Community Center
cards.desc: Once during each player’s turn, if they played a Supporter card from their hand this turn, they may heal 10 damage from each of their Pokémon.

cards.name: Perilous Jungle
cards.desc: During Pokémon Checkup, put 2 more damage counters on each Poisoned non-{D} Pokémon (both yours and your opponent’s).

cards.name: Full Metal Lab
cards.desc: {M} Pokémon (both yours and your opponent’s) take 30 less damage from attacks from the opponent’s Pokémon (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

cards.name: Academy at Night
cards.desc: Once during each player’s turn, that player may put a card from their hand on top of their deck.

cards.name: Lively Stadium
cards.desc: Each Basic Pokémon in play (both yours and your opponent’s) gets +30 HP.

cards.name: Gravity Mountain
cards.desc: Each Stage 2 Pokémon in play (both yours and your opponent’s) gets -30 HP.

cards.name: Levincia
cards.desc: Once during each player’s turn, that player may put up to 2 Basic {L} Energy cards from their discard pile into their hand.

cards.name: Risky Ruins
cards.desc: Whenever any player puts a Basic non-{D} Pokémon onto their Bench during their turn, place 2 damage counters on that Pokémon.
